cover_letter:
Dear Exhibitly team,

I'm writing to apply for the Customer Success / Onboarding (co-builder) role. What drew me to Exhibitly is the challenge you've set yourselves: going from 250 to 1,000 events, and building the customer success function from scratch. The fact that the founders have handled every onboarding so far shows how critical this role is, and I'm excited by the opportunity to take that ownership and create a scalable, automated process.

My experience sits at the intersection of digital marketing, technical implementation, and client-facing work. As a freelance SEO and WordPress specialist, I've built and optimised websites for clients, managed their content, and used AI tools to automate research, reporting, and documentation. At Episto, I work with multiple client websites, handling on-page SEO, content management, and reporting with tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics. This has taught me to be organised across different projects and time zones, to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, and to own outcomes from start to finish.

I'm comfortable with the technical side: I've implemented structured data, worked with APIs, and built automation scripts in Python. I use LLMs daily to draft, research, and document, which means I can move fast and handle a high volume of work without sacrificing quality. I genuinely enjoy helping customers succeed—seeing a client's event go better than expected is what motivates me.

While I haven't worked in the events industry, I've built and optimised websites for a range of clients, and I'm confident I can quickly understand Exhibitly's product and translate client needs into actionable insights for the team. I'm fluent in English, have native Turkish, and am improving my Dutch, which I believe can be an asset in the Belgian market.

I'm eager to bring my mix of customer focus, technical understanding, and AI-native workflow to Exhibitly. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help you scale customer success and turn happy events into renewals and expansions.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
